interface.longDescription: Agent skills for the pgedge CLI. They manage pgEdge Starfleet Managed and BYOC databases, Starfleet accounts, and a self-hosted pgEdge Control Plane by running pgedge commands and reading the CLI's built-in reference. The skills install the CLI when it is missing.
